trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Complete all other trophies to unlock this platinum trophy. This is the final trophy in the game that represents achieving 100% completion.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission called 'Gone Fishing'. This is the first mission you play through when starting the game and introduces you to the basic controls and gameplay mechanics.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the main story campaign. This chapter typically introduces the protagonist's backstory and the early events in Leonida.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the main story campaign. This chapter usually involves deeper involvement with the criminal underworld and expanding your territory.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3 of the main story campaign. This chapter often focuses on establishing your criminal empire and dealing with major conflicts.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the main story campaign. This is typically the final chapter of the main storyline, leading to the climactic confrontation.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the main story campaign. This concludes the primary narrative arc of the game and unlocks the platinum trophy.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission called 'Breakfast Run'. This early mission helps establish relationships with key characters and provides initial story progression.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'The Cartel Heist'. This is an early heist mission that teaches you about planning and executing criminal operations.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission 'Child's Play'. This mission typically involves a family-related subplot that develops character relationships.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Headliners'. This mission often deals with media influence and public perception in the game world.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission 'VCIA Takedown'. This mission involves targeting government or law enforcement assets.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. This mission typically occurs in winter conditions and involves strategic operations.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% game completion. This includes completing all main story missions, side missions, collectibles, and achievements to achieve full game completion.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunts throughout the game. Stunts can be performed on vehicles or while on foot and are scattered throughout the open world.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 different activity types once. These include things like driving, shooting, stealth, etc., to experience various gameplay elements.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Complete all 42 Shooting Range challenges with gold medals. These challenges are located in the shooting range areas and test accuracy and precision.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 different locations. These races are competitive and require skill in drone piloting.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. These can be various types of races including street races, time trials, and other competitive events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Defeat Cal in a fishing challenge. This is a specific fishing competition that requires skill and patience.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game. These are typically mini-games found in various locations throughout the city.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. This is a side mission that becomes available after completing certain prerequisites and is considered missable.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission. This side mission is part of the character's story arc and can be missed if not completed in time.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. This side quest is part of a character's storyline that can be missed if not pursued properly.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger strands. These are side missions involving characters you encounter in the world, each providing a unique story thread.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission. This side mission is part of a character's storyline and may be missed if not completed in time.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. This is a character-specific side quest that can be missed if not pursued at the right time.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots throughout Leonida. These spots are scattered around the map and provide a peaceful experience.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. This involves tracking and capturing a specific wildlife species that is required for the character's quest.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. These are typically found in the game's card collecting system and require gathering specific cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. This involves performing the WAiNK action (a specific game mechanic) at various locations scattered throughout the world.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. These are various objectives and tasks that can be completed throughout the game world.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and successfully escape. This requires coordination with your companion to manage police attention.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while maintaining your wanted level. This requires careful timing and coordination with your companion.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles throughout the game. These vehicles are scattered across the open world and can be found in various locations.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus activation. This requires precise timing and positioning to maximize damage output.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA in an unscheduled way. This typically involves bypassing normal exit procedures to escape the facility.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos (tanks). This involves fighting or surviving encounters with tank vehicles in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen by security or guards. This requires stealth and planning to avoid detection.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape successfully. These are high-stakes heist missions that require careful planning and execution.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. This involves a high-risk heist that requires speed and precision.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. This requires visiting every region of the game's map to complete the exploration objective.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. This involves targeting different criminal organizations and their operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a social activity that can be enjoyed in specific locations.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in style. This involves destroying property in a dramatic fashion to escape.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. This is a recreational activity that involves competing in bowling games.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This refers to specific cooperative gameplay moments with other players or characters.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices (PSN tracks a count to 500). This involves making numerous decisions throughout the game that affect the storyline and outcomes.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. This requires failing an objective once and then succeeding on the retry attempt.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange. This involves experiencing unusual or mysterious events in the game world.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. This involves using melee weapons while driving a vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills. This involves using contacts to process illegally obtained money.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in shops. This requires purchasing items from various vendors throughout the game world.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. This involves purchasing and upgrading various garage facilities throughout the game.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. This involves registering vehicles for use in the game's scooter system.
